recipes.name: FALAFEL
ingredients: 1 tbsp cumin seeds or 2 tsp ground cumin
2 tsp coriander seed or 1 1/2 tsp ground coriander
1/4 cup loosely packed parsley leaves*, roughly chopped
3 tbsp loosely packed dill fronds, roughly chopped
3 tbsp loosely packed mint leaves, roughly chopped
3 1/2 tbsp all purpose flour or chickpea flour
As needed peanut, canola, or vegetable oil
1/4 cup *alternatively substitute: parsley and 1/4 Cup cilantro
6 oz dried chickpeas or 12 oz pre cooked (canned) chickpeas
To garnish: sweet paprika or sumac
instructions: For the Falafel
Add the chickpeas to a large sealable container with water and salt. Let the chickpeas soak overnight at room temperature. - 8 oz dried chickpeas - 32 oz water - 1 tbsp kosher salt
Once the chickpeas have doubled or tripled in volume, drain and rinse them thoroughly. Reserve until ready to use.

Toast spices in a medium skillet over medium heat for 3-4 minutes. Make sure to toss or stir them periodically. Reserve them until ready to use. - 1 tbsp cumin seeds or 2 tsp ground cumin - 2 tsp coriander seed or 1 1/2 tsp ground coriander - ¼ tsp Aleppo pepper
Add chickpeas, garlic, and onion to the food processor. Process until roughly chopped, about 30 seconds. - 8 oz dried chickpeas - 2 garlic cloves roughly chopped - 1 small yellow onion large diced

Add the herbs, lemon zest, salt, pepper, and pulse until finely chopped. Add the baking powder and flour, pulse 2 or 3 times to combine the dry ingredients. The mixture should not be a paste but still, hold together when scooped. - ¼ cup loosely packed parsley leaves* roughly chopped - 3 tbsp loosely packed dill fronds roughly chopped - 3 tbsp loosely packed mint leaves roughly chopped - 2 tsp lemon zest - 2 tsp kosher salt - 1 tsp freshly ground black pepper - 1 tsp baking powder - 3 ½ tbsp all purpose flour or chickpea flour
Shape the falafel mixture into golf ball-sized spheres for deep frying or patties for baking or pan-frying.
Allow the shaped falafel to rest for a minimum of 30 minutes in the refrigerator.

If deep-frying, heat 3 inches of oil in a large high-sided skillet to 325°F. Fry each falafel ball for 4-5 minutes or until well browned. Make sure not to overcrowd the pan, fry the falafel in batches. Transfer the fried falafel to a sheet tray lined with paper towels. - As needed peanut canola, or vegetable oil

If pan-frying, preheat a large skillet with just enough oil to completely cover the bottom of the pan. Once the oil is shimmering, add the falafel patties and cook for 4-5 minutes on each side. Transfer the falafel to a large plate. - As needed peanut canola, or vegetable oil

If baking, preheat the oven to 350°F with a fan (or 375°F without a fan). Brush a large rimmed baking sheet with a generous layer of oil. Gently place the falafel patties on the sheet tray and brush them with more oil. Bake for 15-20 minutes, flipping halfway through. - As needed peanut canola, or vegetable oil
Serve the falafel warm with a side of hummus and/or a drizzle of tahini sauce.
For the Hummus
Soak in water with salt. Skip steps 1-3 if you are using pre-cooked chickpeas. - 28 oz water - 1 tbsp kosher salt
Drain, rinse, measure chickpeas. - 6 oz dried chickpeas or 12 oz pre cooked (canned) chickpeas
Simmer chickpeas for 2 hours then, once again, drain and rinse the chickpeas
Combine chickpeas and garlic in the base of the food processor. Process until the mixture becomes homogeneous and relatively smooth. - 2 cloves garlic

With the machine still running, add the lemon juice, tahini, olive oil, and enough ice water to reach a smooth consistency. Process for 4-5 minutes until the hummus is smooth and fluffy. - 1 Juice of lemon - ⅓ cup Tahini - ½ cup extra virgin olive oil - ¼ cup ice water
Season the hummus with salt.
Reserve in the refrigerator until ready to use for up to 5 days.
For the Tahini Sauce
Combine tahini, lemon juice, cumin, and garlic in a small bowl. Whisk until well until combined. - ½ cup tahini - ¼ cup freshly squeezed lemon juice - ½ tsp ground cumin - 1 garlic clove minced
Slowly stream in the water while whisking until the desired thickness has been achieved. - ¼ cup ice water
Season to taste with salt. - To taste kosher salt
Reserve until ready to use or in the refrigerator for 5 days.
